title: Settings page shows the four Require settings under Workflow, Line, Parts groups
custom_preconds:
1. Sign in as an Owner or Admin (top-right shows your name and the shop).

2. Open the work-order settings page: in the left sidebar under SETTINGS click "Settings", then click the "Work Orders" tab at the top of the page (the page with the WORKFLOW, LINE REQUIREMENTS and PARTS toggle groups and a "Save Settings" button).
custom_steps:
1. Open Settings -> the "Work Orders" tab (left sidebar "Settings", then the "Work Orders" tab).

2. Read the setting labels and how the page is grouped.
custom_expected:
1. The page shows four toggles: "Require ordering parts", "Require picking inventory parts", "Require receiving parts before completion", and "Require approval for new lines".

2. The page is grouped into "Workflow", "Line requirements" and "Parts", separated by dividers.

3. Every label reads in the "Require..." form, so turning one on always means more work.

This is the expected behaviour as per epic SV-8683 and story SV-9247 (Story 1, Work Order settings page) and the Simple Flow V2 specification (Confluence page 771391574, revised 8 September 2026), read on 9 September 2026.

Last checked against build v26.39.0-07c719b on 9/24/2026.
